body: This shouldn’t be possible The three biggest categories at the 2027 Grammys — Record of the Year, Album of the Year, and Song of the Year — have zero hip-hop representation. The closest any rapper came to the major categories is being nominated for Best New Artist, despite releasing his first album in 2020. Who do you think deserved an AOTY or Song/Record OTY nomination?
